posts.description: Turn any product into a scroll-stopping UGC ad with the avatar physically holding it. 3 steps, no creator to hire. Free account, buy credits when you're ready.

posts.name: WakeMark
posts.tagline: X / Twitter Bookmark Manager with AI Digest & MCP
posts.description: WakeMark is an X/Twitter bookmark manager that auto-tags your saves, emails an AI digest, and lets you chat—or connect via MCP in Cursor and Claude.

posts.name: mydreampc - pc simulator
posts.tagline: Interactive PC simulator, game FPS estimates & AI assistant.
posts.description: DreamPC is an interactive PC building simulator designed to unify hardware validation into a single dynamic dashboard. Built as my Computer Engineering capstone project, it uses a custom deterministic engine to deliver real-time PSU headroom calculations, bottleneck analysis, physical clearance checks, and game FPS estimates—all in one view. It also features an integrated AI assistant to help users navigate technical hardware concepts instantly.

posts.name: omadesign
posts.tagline: Native Linux studio for design, paint, photo & motion
posts.description: omadesign is an open-source (MIT) native Linux studio for designers who left macOS — or never had a clean Affinity/Illustrator-shaped seat on Linux. Design, Pixel, Photo, and Motion share one document and layer stack. v0.0.4-alpha. Built to sit down and make work, not babysit Electron.

posts.name: Avos
posts.tagline: Automated payroll and HR for teams in 8 countries
posts.description: Avos automates payroll end to end: income tax, social contributions, benefits and payslips calculated with each country's up-to-date tables. Calculation engines for 8 countries, multi-company accounts for accounting firms, plus a built-in time clock, expenses, leave, org chart and an AI assistant that answers questions about your own payroll data. 5 languages, audit log on every change, AES-256 encryption. 7-day free trial, no credit card.

posts.name: drillr
posts.tagline: drillr — The Idea Engine for Fundamental Investors
posts.description: Drillr is a fundamental research workspace for investors and AI agents. Unlike screeners that need a ticker or web search that returns disconnected pages, it finds companies from a description of what they do. It connects filings, financials, earnings calls, ownership, news and events in one research path, with every reported figure linked to its source. Daily research and watchlists keep the work moving. Use it in the browser, through MCP or via REST API.

posts.name: Kalkulatory Paliwowe
posts.tagline: Free fuel cost & trip calculators for Polish drivers
posts.description: Sprawdź, ile pali Twój samochód i ile kosztuje przejazd. Darmowy kalkulator spalania paliwa wpisz dystans, paliwo i cenę, a otrzymasz wynik w kilka sekund.

posts.name: Viovi Focus
posts.tagline: A distraction-free focus timer with zero bloat
posts.description: One tap starts a session. A Live Activity on your lock screen shows progress without opening the app. Daily history tracks how much focused time you actually logged — no badges, no guilt-tripping notifications. Built solo with React Native/Expo. Free trial, no credit card required.

posts.name: Oats
posts.tagline: Open source meeting notes that never leave your Mac
posts.description: Oats records, transcribes, and summarizes your meetings entirely on your Mac. No bot joins your call, no audio leaves your machine, no account, no subscription. Live transcription with speaker labels, action items collected across meetings, a knowledge graph linking people, projects, and topics, and a Spotlight-style Ask popup. Pick your models: Apple Intelligence, Ollama, Whisper, or Parakeet. Notes are plain files on disk. Free and open source under Apache 2.0.

posts.name: AskPreceptor
posts.tagline: AskPreceptor - Clinical cases for med students
posts.description: AskPreceptor is a study tool for medical and health students. You work through teaching cases and get the reasoning a good clinician would use — not just an answer, but why that answer and why not the others. Every answer names the guidance it leaned on, and a citation the app could not verify against its own corpus is marked with a warning. You are told what to double-check rather than asked to trust everything equally.

posts.name: TickrDash
posts.tagline: Live scores, standings, stocks and more on any tablet or TV.
posts.description: TickrDash. Look up, stay ahead.

posts.name: Wanna Contact
posts.tagline: Your AI DM assistant
posts.description: Place your exclusive link on your social media. AI will receive visitors, identify cooperation intentions, and only forward the right people to you.

posts.name: GreenRah
posts.tagline: The cooler way
posts.description: GreenRah is a heat-smart walking map for hotter cities. Instead of sending you only on the fastest path, it compares sun, shade, weather, slope, and thermal comfort to help you choose a cooler, gentler walk. See shade ahead, compare route comfort, find drinking water and public toilets, and choose accessible paths with easier slopes. Built for commuters, visitors, families, older adults, and anyone who feels city heat first. Starting in EU and GB.

posts.name: Listing Price Watch
posts.tagline: Price Drop Alerts for Zillow & Redfin
posts.description: Get notified when a Zillow or Redfin listing you're watching drops in price. No background scraping — private by design. House hunting means checking the same listings over and over, hoping you don't miss a price cut. Listing Price Watch does that for you, but honestly: it doesn't scan the internet in the background. It simply remembers the price each time you look at a listing on Zillow or Redfin, and flags it the next time that price is different.

posts.name: Pro-San
posts.tagline: ProTeam® Vacuum Bags
posts.description: ProTeam vacuum bags, Intercept 10 qt. Fit Super CoachVac, CoachVac, MegaVac. Reusable open collar, dual-layer filtration. 10 per case.

posts.name: Celmis
posts.tagline: Self-hosted code intelligence over a symbol graph
posts.description: Most code tools read one repository at a time. Celmis indexes a set of them into one symbol graph, so a question can cross a boundary: ask which service still calls a function whose signature changed, and the answer comes back with file:line citations from a repository you never cloned. Same index, read many ways: PR review that sees cross-repo callers, dependency audit, CycloneDX SBOM, and an MCP server with 18 tools. Self-hosted, docker compose. Your model key, or Ollama locally. AGPL-3.0.

posts.name: EXIF Cool
posts.tagline: View and edit photo, audio, and video metadata on Mac
posts.description: EXIF Cool is a $5 Mac app for viewing and editing metadata on images, audio, video, and documents. Drop files, browse a grouped tag tree, batch rename from date or camera, strip GPS and personal info, add location, and edit cover art. Apple Silicon only. Not notarized — first launch is right-click → Open. Sold as-is by FatChance; refund via Gumroad if it won’t launch. Powered by ExifTool (Phil Harvey). Audio tags via mutagen.
